name: Akmal Ariq
title: Data & AI Engineer
bio: I am a Data & AI Engineer based in Jakarta, Indonesia, specializing in building modern cloud-native data pipelines and analytics platforms. I am a graduate of the prestigious DataTalks.Club Data Engineering Zoomcamp (2026) and currently work at Bank SMBC Indonesia.

highlights: Specializing in modern data pipelines and enterprise database orchestrations.
Actively working on transitioning into AI Engineering, integrating LLMs and agentic workflows.
Developing internal data solutions to enable data-driven decision making at scale.
Completed rigorous curriculum on core data engineering principles.
Built a cloud-native Earthquake Analytics capstone pipeline using GCP, BigQuery, Kestra, dbt, and Looker Studio.
Mastered advanced concepts: workflow orchestration, dbt transformations, partitioned/clustered warehousing, and Infrastructure as Code.
